#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using i64 = long long;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    i64 cap, flow;
    i64 cost;
    Edge(int t, int r, i64 c, i64 w) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), flow(0), cost(w) {}
};

class MinCostFlowSolver {
public:
    int n;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> graph;
    std::vector<i64> dist, potential, prev_node, prev_edge;
    std::vector<bool> visited;

    MinCostFlowSolver(int size) : n(size), graph(size), dist(size), potential(size, 0), 
                                   prev_node(size), prev_edge(size), visited(size, false) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, i64 cap, i64 cost) {
        graph[from].emplace_back(to, graph[to].size(), cap, cost);
        graph[to].emplace_back(from, graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost);
    }

    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), std::numeric_limits<i64>::max());
        std::fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), false);
        dist[s] = 0;

        using pii = std::pair<i64, int>;
        std::priority_queue<pii, std::vector<pii>, std::greater<pii>> pq;
        pq.emplace(0, s);

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (visited[u]) continue;
            visited[u] = true;

            for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                auto &e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to]) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                    prev_node[e.to] = u;
                    prev_edge[e.to] = i;
                    pq.emplace(dist[e.to], e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < std::numeric_limits<i64>::max();
    }

    std::pair<i64, i64> max_flow_min_cost(int s, int t) {
        i64 total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;

        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] < std::numeric_limits<i64>::max()) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
            }

            i64 bottleneck = std::numeric_limits<i64>::max();
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prev_node[v]) {
                auto &e = graph[prev_node[v]][prev_edge[v]];
                bottleneck = std::min(bottleneck, e.cap - e.flow);
            }

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prev_node[v]) {
                auto &e = graph[prev_node[v]][prev_edge[v]];
                e.flow += bottleneck;
                graph[v][e.rev].flow -= bottleneck;
                total_cost += bottleneck * e.cost;
            }
            total_flow += bottleneck;
        }

        return {total_flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    i64 c, d;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    std::vector<int> count(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        std::cin >> x;
        count[x]++;
    }

    // Build graph with time-expanded network
    // We'll use at most k*n minutes
    int max_time = k * n + 1;
    int total_nodes = max_time * n + 2;
    int source = 0, sink = total_nodes - 1;

    MinCostFlowSolver solver(total_nodes);

    // Add edges for waiting
    for (int t = 0; t < max_time - 1; ++t) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            solver.add_edge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }

    // Add edges for walking along streets
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        std::cin >> u >> v;
        for (int t = 0; t < max_time - 1; ++t) {
            // For each minute t, person can move from u to v or v to u
            // The cost for j people walking on the same street in the same direction at the same time is j^2 * d
            // We model this by adding multiple edges with increasing marginal cost
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; ++j) {
                solver.add_edge(t * n + u, (t + 1) * n + v, 1, (2 * j - 1) * d + c);
                solver.add_edge(t * n + v, (t + 1) * n + u, 1, (2 * j - 1) * d + c);
            }
        }
    }

    // Connect node 1 (leader's house) to sink
    for (int t = 0; t < max_time; ++t) {
        solver.add_edge(t * n + 1, sink, k, 0);
    }

    // Connect source to starting positions
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (count[i] > 0) {
            solver.add_edge(source, i, count[i], 0);
        }
    }

    auto result = solver.max_flow_min_cost(source, sink);
    std::cout << result.second << '\n';

    return 0;
}
